newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's De Rigo H1 1996 profit 39.5 bln lir.
newsitem.headline: Italy's De Rigo H1 1996 profit 39.5 bln lir.

text.p: Italian sunglasses manufacturer De Rigo said it had first half 1996 net profit of 39.5 billion lire, or 23.6 percent of sales equal to 167.8 billion lire.
The New York quoted company gave no comparisons in a statement.
For the full-year 1995, De Rigo posted net profit of 69.2 billion lire on turnover of 301.6 billion lire.
The company said it had a cash surplus of over 136 billion lire in the first six months this year and made investments equal to seven billion lire.
De Rigo said it planned to launch this month both in Italy and abroad a new line of sports glasses in collaboration with Italian sports clothing and footwear group Fila.
